brief: A resort-town house in Petoskey: Frank Lesher's house, as photographed — see the photo for its massing and trim. One photo; year estimated. Older than 1970: Petoskey's resort-town streets (the town's model) were built 1880-1930, and Commons has almost no newer cottages there. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: the Frank Lesher House (Petoskey, 1900): a 1.5-storey side-gabled cottage (gable to the side street) in blue vinyl, a hip-roofed entry porch on painted turned posts with a lattice-skirted deck, a later wooden deck at the back

why.note: vinyl siding and a pressure-treated deck: the 1990s-2000s update
